senses.sense_definition: Lacking interesting or distinctive features that make something easy to recognize.

examples.text: The suspect escaped in a <w>nondescript</w> grey van that no one could identify.
She lived in a <w>nondescript</w> apartment building that looked exactly like all the others on the street.

senses.sense_definition: Not yet formally documented or categorized in academic or scientific literature.

examples.text: The biologist discovered a <w>nondescript</w> insect species in the remote rainforest.
Many deep-sea organisms remain <w>nondescript</w> due to the difficulty of exploring the ocean floor.

senses.sense_definition: A person or thing that is ordinary and lacks any special qualities.

examples.text: The crowd was filled with <w>nondescripts</w> who blended perfectly into the busy city background.
He felt like a total <w>nondescript</w> at the party, as nobody seemed to notice him.

senses.sense_definition: A vehicle used by law enforcement that does not have visible markings or lights.

examples.text: The officer pulled the speeding driver over using an unmarked <w>nondescript</w>.
Detectives often prefer using a <w>nondescript</w> to conduct surveillance without being noticed.

senses.sense_definition: A living creature that has not been previously identified or classified by science.

examples.text: The expedition team struggled to classify the strange <w>nondescript</w> they found in the cave.
Taxonomists are still debating the origin of the mysterious <w>nondescript</w> captured on camera.
